summary: This Apache configuration snippet prevents direct access to three specific JSON files by denying all requests to them. It uses a pattern match to identify the files and then blocks anyone from viewing them through the web server.

explanations.1: Options -Indexes disables directory listing, so if someone visits a folder URL, they won't see a list of files in that directory.
explanations.3: FilesMatch uses a regex pattern (the ^ and $ anchors mean 'from start to end') to identify exactly these three filenames, nothing more and nothing less.
explanations.4: Require all denied is the rule that actually blocks access — it tells the web server to reject every request for files matching the pattern above.
